header.title: Publications
header.subtitle: Three meticulously crafted books designed to build strong foundations and advanced problem-solving skills.

ekam-1.title: Ekam-1
ekam-1.subtitle: Foundation - Part 1
ekam-1.description: A foundational book designed to build strong basic concepts in education. Perfect for early learners looking for structured guidance.
ekam-1.long_description: Ekam-1 is the definitive starting point for students seeking a rock-solid grasp of mathematical fundamentals. Every chapter is meticulously sequenced to build intuition before skill, ensuring concepts stick for life—not just for exams.

aagvu-ganit.title: Aagvu Ganit
aagvu-ganit.subtitle: Advanced Mathematics
aagvu-ganit.description: An advanced mathematics guide providing deep analytical insights, shortcuts, and comprehensive problem-solving techniques.
aagvu-ganit.long_description: Aagvu Ganit is for the ambitious student. It goes beyond routine problem-solving to teach analytical thinking, shortcut methods, and competition-level strategies that transform how students approach mathematics.

ekam-2.title: Ekam-2
ekam-2.subtitle: Foundation - Part 2
ekam-2.description: The highly anticipated sequel, bringing advanced foundational concepts with modern pedagogical approaches.
ekam-2.long_description: Building on the proven methodology of Ekam-1, this sequel dives deeper into advanced foundational concepts. With modern pedagogical design, concept maps, and integrated digital resources, Ekam-2 is the next evolution in structured learning.
